text:
maya.chen: Quick heads-up — Pivotal Labs confirmed a customer story with us. We need to coordinate: 30–45 min interview, final quote verification, signed asset/photo release, and permission to use their logo in promo. They prefer Wed/Thu morning PT next week. Also ask for a one-line benchmark blurb (latency & cost).

josh_prod: I can run the recording and do a light edit. Wed 10am PT works. I'll share a prep checklist (mic, screen share, Loom fallback) and a short agenda.

sam_cs: I've asked their eng lead for metrics. Draft they sent: "Switching to Redwood cut inference cost by ~40% and reduced p99 from ~520ms to ~180ms in production." I'll confirm exact figures today and paste their approval here.

elena_legal: Before publishing we need a signed release and explicit written approval of the quote text. Upload the standard asset release and ask them to e-sign (should take <2 mins). I'll clear the quote once signed.

priya_marketing: For promotion and webinar routing: we'll build a landing page and route inbound signups to SDR queue 'webinar-pivotal'. Can we also use one headshot in the hero beside the logo? Need logo files + brand usage guidelines.

maya.chen: @priya_marketing yes route to webinar-pivotal. @sam_cs please request logo + headshot from their comms lead. I'll double-check benchmark wording with them to keep it short and defensible.

lily_sales: Add me to the lead routing (lily_sales). If a lead marks enterprise interest, forward to enterprise-sales@redwood. Also suggest adding optional 15-min meeting slot post-webinar in the RSVP flow.

josh_prod: Proposed recording slots in the prep doc:
```
- Wed 2025-07-09 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT)
- Thu 2025-07-10 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT)
```
I'll include Loom link for async option and a short recording script.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Pivotal Labs — Customer Story Recording" — Wed Jul 9 2025 17:00:00 UTC — invites: maya.chen, josh_prod, sam_cs, priya_marketing, elena_legal, lily_sales.

elena_legal: Standard release uploaded: https://company.internal/legal/releases/pivotal-story-release-v1.pdf — please request e-sign and CC me. Once I have the signed release I'll review the final quote text.

sam_cs: They responded and approved the numbers on email: "Confirmed: ~40% cost reduction and p99 ~180ms are accurate for our production workload after optimizations." CC'd their comms contact on the release request.

maya.chen: Great. I'll send the release link and ask for logo + headshot. Priya — after assets arrive, draft the landing + social copy. Keep it tight: 1-line impact + two bullets (throughput, cost). Also prepare an A/B headline for testing.

priya_marketing: Will draft landing copy and two headline variants; ETA EOD tomorrow. Also prepping registration form to include optional 15-min meeting slot and a checkbox for enterprise interest.

maya.chen: Thanks team. Using this thread as the single source of truth for approvals and assets. I'll paste the signed release and final quote here when complete. :rocket:
